# Pivot sample workbooks

Generated by `PivotSampleTests` (set `ONEDOCUMENT_PIVOT_SAMPLES_OUT` to this folder to rewrite them): each is a small data sheet and one pivot table
whose cache started as field names only, refreshed and saved by this library. They are committed unanswered. The questions to settle in Excel, per file:

| File | Check |
|---|---|
| all | opens without a repair prompt; the pivot shows the same cells without a refresh; after Refresh All the cells and the `location` do not change |
| `compact-rows`, `rows-and-columns`, `no-grand-totals` | `firstHeaderRow`/`firstDataRow`/`firstDataCol`; which of `rowGrandTotals`/`colGrandTotals` removes the Grand Total row and which the column |
| `outline-two-fields`, `tabular-two-fields`, `compact-two-fields`, `subtotals-at-bottom` | label placement, subtotal rows and captions (`Region Total`), indent of compact children |
| `two-data-fields`, `two-data-fields-and-columns` | the data field row/column placement, `Total Sum of Sales` captions, `i` and `x v` of the data entries in `rowItems`/`colItems` |
| `summary-functions`, `show-values-as` | values, `#DIV/0!` for one-item variance, number formats of percent forms, which cells of the difference and running-total forms are empty |
| `report-filter` | where the page field sits, the shown item, `rowPageCount`/`colPageCount` |
| `date-groups`, `number-ranges` | group item labels (`<1/15/2020`, `1-3`), the order of the `<` and `>` items, the label of the last range |
| `calculated-field` | the formula runs on sums, not on records |
| `mixed-types` | the `sharedItems` flags and which fields store their values inline |
| `hidden-item` | hidden items stay out of the totals |

Excel's answers go next to the files as they come back; nothing here has been run through Excel yet.
